Autonomous building operations · fictional reference property

PLATO-40 synthetic dataset, proximata Hackathon '26 · Rhomberg track (CC BY 4.0). Every finding concerns the fictional PLATO-40 only. Simulated effects are labelled; nothing here was measured on a real building.
Created by Alf-David Heermann, alfheermann@gmail.com · API description (Swagger)
Voice
In a loud room: hold the button or the space bar while you speak, release when done. The microphone is closed in between, so the room cannot talk to the assistant. Typing works as well. Approvals happen only on your clear yes; effects are simulated.
